name: ANSI/IEEE wire splice symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for wire splice, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The splice form identifies intentional continuity among documented conductors without a detachable mating connection. A splice identifier and wiring detail establish its construction and joined conductors; nearby lines alone do not establish a splice.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Distinguish a joined node from an unconnected conductor crossing.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A splice creates permanent continuity while a connector provides a separable mating interface.
